object_description: five-story wing with a staggered seven-story head building
design_condition: The new volume completes the formal order of the existing buildings by aligning a long wing with them and stepping a taller head toward the urban fabric, while openings, paths and southern greenery connect the complex to its surroundings.

positive.statement: The new body establishes a clear dialogue with the neighborhood and the monumental existing buildings.
The rhythm of full and empty spaces is uniform and clear, making the citadel layout legible.
The paths are clear and well delineated.
The existing roof typology is recovered as a strong trademark that gives the new construction personality.
The linear and simple coworking and costudying layout can be recalibrated for new needs.
The new building has good envelope characteristics, with an optimal insulation level and opaque-to-glass ratio.

negative.statement: The southern area needs further study to prevent it from becoming a residual space of poor quality.
The relationship between green and mineral surfaces and the arrangement of trees should be reconsidered.
The complex ground-floor roof structure is not completely resolved and should be substantially reworked.
The alignment of the load-bearing system between the two building bodies and the facade portals still needs to be checked.
The decentralized ventilation proposal must be verified in depth for its suitability for certification.
The ecological and health aspects of the materials are not explicitly addressed.
